description.short_caption: Mucicarmine stain highlighting fungal structures with pink-red staining.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a mucicarmine stain of a specimen, highlighting fungal elements. The fungal structures appear as pink to red-stained areas, consistent with mucopolysaccharide-containing capsules. The background tissue is lightly stained, allowing clear visualization of the fungal elements. This staining technique is often used to identify encapsulated fungi, such as Cryptococcus species.

description.short_caption: Hematoxylin and eosin stain showing numerous yeast forms with surrounding inflammation.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image, stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), shows numerous round to oval yeast forms scattered throughout the tissue. The yeast forms appear as darkly stained structures, some of which may exhibit budding. The background shows a mixed inflammatory infiltrate, suggesting an infectious process. The image is at medium magnification.
visible_findings: numerous round to oval yeast forms
